recipes.name: State Fair Crêpes
ingredients_raw: 3 tablespoons butter, or as needed - divided
6 firm bananas, sliced in half lengthwise
12 tablespoons chocolate-hazelnut spread (such as Nutella®), divided
1 teaspoon confectioners' sugar for dusting, or as needed
1 tablespoon chocolate syrup, or as needed

steps.text: Blend milk, eggs, 1 tablespoon melted butter, white sugar, almond extract, and flour in a blender into a smooth batter, 1 to 2 minutes. Allow the batter to rest while you finish the remaining steps, at least 20 minutes.
Cook the bacon in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes; drain on a paper towel-lined plate.

Melt 1 teaspoon butter on a crêpe pan or in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Pour in 1/4 cup batter, swirl the pan to evenly coat the entire bottom of the pan with the thin batter, and cook until small brown spots appear on the bottom of crêpe, 2 to 3 minutes.
Carefully loosen crêpe from pan and gently flip to cook other side, 1 to 2 more minutes. Crêpe is done when batter in center is set and a few small brown spots appear on 2nd side.
Slide crêpe onto a plate lined with a piece of parchment paper. Cook remaining crêpes, buttering the pan when needed, and stack cooked crêpes between pieces of parchment paper.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet and cook the sliced bananas until golden brown on both sides, about 3 minutes per side. Set bananas aside.
To assemble, place a crêpe onto a serving plate and spread 1 tablespoon of chocolate hazelnut spread and 1 tablespoon peanut butter over the crêpe.
Place a bacon strip in the center of the crêpe and top bacon with a banana half. Drizzle about 1/2 teaspoon of honey over the banana half.
Roll up the crêpe into a cylinder shape; dust with confectioners' sugar and a drizzle of chocolate syrup. Repeat with remaining ingredients to make 12 filled crêpes.

raw_recipe.headline: State Fair Crêpes
raw_recipe.description: Thin and elegant crêpes are spread with peanut butter and hazelnut spread and wrapped around bacon and fried bananas for a savory-sweet, fancy brunch dish or dessert that will wow your family and guests.

review.reviewBody: This is one of the most fantastic crepes I have ever tried! The ingredients are measured out perfectly and I can remember my trip to Paris immediately when I taste them. Well done with the toppings and nice work. A treat for breakfast

This was a delicious crepe. The flavors complement each other and everybody that tried them loved the banana and peanut butter combo. We decided to not use Nutella because we don’t care for that product. We will make this again. Thanks for sharing this recipe!

I made this for a surprise breakfast for my teenage kids. They were skeptical about the combo of bacon and sweet but loved it! The few I made for my son, I ran out of peanut butter so topped with a scoop of peanut butter cookie dough ice cream. They have requested I make this again, told them maybe as a back to school treat next fall since this should be a once in a while thing
Yummy i make it it's yummy I try peanut butter also it's yummy too... Thanks for sharing

Made this recipe and it brought me back to France when I was there in 2009. We went to a French bistrio and had these amazing crepes and these were in the same League. The only thing missing was the cappuccino, so next time I'll couple the crepes with a steamy cappocino sprinkled with cinnamon. Loved the crepes!

I was craving something with Nutella so I gave this a try. They were delicious. I did not add bacon because I do not have any but they were great either way. The only other time I had tried crepes was at IHOP and I did not care much for them so I was hesitant and only made half a batch, should of made the full recipe. While warming the bananas for my husbands, I added a few pecans for crunch and they were even more delicious. He even loved the crepes themselves without any topping. Will be making these regularly from now on
It was soooo delicious!! Saltiness from bacon and sweets makes good marriage! Thank you for sharing recipe!! :)
LOVED this recipe! great flavor and very rich. definitley will make again. Maybe with some different fruits.
